records.name: Flag Football @ Penn
records.summary: Penn students who play competitive flag football and enter college tournaments. The group welcomes women and says no experience is needed.
records.what_you_do: Learn and play flag football, and compete in collegiate tournaments with the team.

first_step.how: Join the group's GroupMe chat, linked from its Penn Clubs page, and follow the club on Instagram.
first_step.basis: The club says no experience is needed and the group chat is the way in. The directory flags an application but does not say what it involves.

records.notes: Directory status is PRELIMINARY, founded 2025-10-31, no dated events, so probably_active rests on the directory alone. Application flag set but not described. The website field is a GroupMe join link.

records.name: Freaks of the Beat
records.summary: Penn's breakdance group. Members learn and perform breaking, train at regular practices, and help run an annual jam. Beginners can start with a weekly lesson.
records.what_you_do: Come to the weekly beginner lesson and the free practice sessions, and help at Rhythmic Damage, the group's jam each November.

schedule.text: Three practices a week: one beginner lesson and two free practice sessions. Times are not listed on the club's site. Intro workshops run one or two times a semester.

first_step.how: Come to an intro night or a free practice, or send the club a direct message on social media. There is no audition and no dance experience is needed.
first_step.basis: There is a weekly beginner lesson and intro workshops, and any Penn student can drop in to practice without an audition.

records.notes: The club's own site lists Rhythmic Damage XIX on Nov 21, 2026. That is a future date and is counted as current activity. Practice times are not listed. The site email is obfuscated, so the directory email is used. Newcomer 5 because beginner lessons and drop in practice are both offered.
